title: Her Majesty’s Swarm
label: Quick read (from summaries)
sources: https://api.mangadex.org/manga?title=Her Majesty's Swarm (MangaDex metadata for title 559be949-4475-4f06-b8bf-a1a7343489bc)
premise: A young woman who played the insect 'Arachnea' faction in an online strategy game wakes in a similar world as queen of a swarm of giant arachnids. After humans kill one of her insects and knights burn a village of her elf allies, she launches a war of conquest against the human kingdoms, whose church worships a 'God of Light'. The story follows her as a villainous protagonist.
life_message: Power used without restraint is presented as the way to protect one's own and settle grievances; the story invites readers to watch a conqueror rather than a hero.

folkways.japan: The hive's total obedience to its queen and the 'game-world' isekai frame are common genre conventions in Japanese web fiction, noted as context rather than as Japanese values.

delivery.evidence: Reader reviews debate whether the author 'knows it's messed up'; none call it preachy (light novel reviews, to verify for manga).

delivery.note: The swarm's grievances are given sympathy while its atrocities are shown in full; how fairly the human church is drawn is unconfirmed.

winners_losers: The swarm and its elf allies win battles; human kingdoms and their church lose. Reader reviews split on whether the queen's view gets endorsement or horrified observation.
